sloka: चुक्रुशुः वीर वीर इति भूयः क्रोशन्ती ताः प्रियम् ।तारा प्रभृतयः सर्वा वानर्यो हत बान्धव ॥४-२५-३५॥
transliteration: cukruśuḥ vīra vīra iti bhūyaḥ krośantī tāḥ priyam ।tārā prabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hata bāndhava ॥4-25-35॥

translations.english: When the female monkeys were weeping in the midst of the forest, it looked as if the forest and the hills were also mourning.
